title: pvConvertPolyhedralCells
body:
## pvConvertPolyhedralCells

Tries to convert polyhedron (and polygon) cells of an unstructured grid into equivalent simple cells (tetrahedron, pyramid, wedge, hexahedron) when their topology allows; cells that cannot be converted stay as they are. Output is an unstructured grid. Use it on meshes from polyhedral-capable readers such as OpenFOAM to speed up later processing and to allow operations that handle simple cells better.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Genuinely polyhedral cells remain polyhedra; the output can still be mixed.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ConvertPolyhedralCells`. Identity: `filters/ConvertPolyhedra`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Convert Polyhedral Cells filter. Accepted data: unstructured grids (vtkUnstructuredGridBase). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkUnstructuredGridBase"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
